notes.title: Patch notes for February 29th
notes.content:
- Mob stuttering when spawning fixed.
- Wizard Meteor Shower nerfed (-5%)
- Few other QOL fixes.

notes.title: Patch notes for February 28th
notes.content:
- Enemies can no longer attack off before fully spawned in.
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: Fixed issue with multiple warrior's taunting at the same time
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with warrior taunts, where they could permanently increase their damage by 2 each time they used the ability. 

Runs abusing this issue were reset back to wave 101.

notes.title: Fixed issue with mob spawning over the server
notes.content: Fixed issue with mobs spawning. Make sure you update the game to avoid any issues with multiplayer.

notes.title: Game Overhaul
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and left us feedback on the game.

We have completely reworked the game and redesigned a lot of the game according to community feedback: 


 We have completely redesigned the boss fights and added a bunch of new mechanics.
 We have added TONS of new items, cosmetics, and abilities into the game. 
 We have completely reworked the lighting in the game, and added many different lighting techniques. to make the game more immersive (flashing / flickering lights, fading lights, etc).
 We have added a public server list, so you can join public lobbies in a friendlier manor. You can still keep your lobbies private and only have players join via a code.
 We have added a NEW FINAL BOSS! With tons of new mechanics. 
 We have tested and made sure that the game is compatible with Steam Deck, as it's a perfect game for the Steam Deck.
 The game has been localized for many additional languages (Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Portuguese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, French, German).
 Additional class abilities has been added for each class. Archers get a wind arrow which can push back all enemies. Priests get an AOE heal which also heals over time. Rogues get a vanish ability which will remove all agro from the rogue. Warriors get a taunt/buff which will force all enemies to attack the warrior, as well as buff the damage of the entire group for 5 seconds. Wizards get a short-cooldown teleport.


In addition to these changes, we have created a new release trailer and updated all the store images.

If you haven't already, please make sure to wishlist the game, and we will see you in-game on February 23rd!

notes.title: Official Game Release Announcement
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our official release date for Dungeon Survivors! 

Dungeon Survivors will be releasing on Friday February 23rd, 2024 at 6PM PST. 

If you haven't yet tried the demo, make sure to check it out! We have already made a lot of changes since the next fest demo based on community feedback! We are avidly listening to our community and will continue to make changes to the game based off community feedback well into release.

For the release you can expect:

 Hundreds of items, weapons and abilities to choose from
 5 Classes to choose from (Warrior, Rogue, Archer, Priest, Wizard)
 Each class has their own set of cards and abilities
 Survive 30 second waves, which gets increasingly harder
 4 Boss waves, after which you fight as long as you can (for a leaderboard spot)
 100+ Waves
 Leaderboard for achieving the highest wave on certain classes/comps
 Random "cards" to choose from each round. Cards can vary in rarity and type
 Play by yourself or with 1-4 player co-op
 Create hundreds of unique characters. Choose from different hair, facial hair, hair color and race 


Thanks, and we will see you in-game on 2/23/24!

notes.title: Demo Release Announcement
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our demo is now available for players to download. The demo demonstrates a early-stage version where elements could be improved or replaced. we would love to know your feedbacks and suggestions!

Our primary goal is to make a game that the community is happy with and cares about. Please give us your feedback on how to make the game better!

Don't Forget to Wishlist Dungeon Survivors!
We will be releasing updates regularly, make sure not to miss the updates by wishlisting the game and receiving all updates about the game!

In the demo version of the game you will get:
- You can play up to Wave 25 (First Boss encounter)
- Priest and Rogue classes will be locked
- Legendary and Mythic items and abilities are removed from the demo deck
- You can still utilize all multiplayer features, and play with up to 3 additional friends!

We are looking forward to any and all feedback. Enjoy the demo!
